paper.title_en: Constraints on Leptoquarks as a Potential Explanation of g−2 of the Muon from Lepton Flavour Violating Processes
paper.abstract_en: This work is dedicated to the investigation of two scalar leptoquark models, usually referred to as $S_1$ and $R_2$ , as potential explanations of the anomaly of the muon magnetic moment $\Delta a_{\mu}$ . It is analysed which requirements have to be fulfilled in order to ensure that these models do indeed account for the detected deviation. Based on the assumption that Δ𝑎𝜇 is explained in such a way, the focus then lies on the lepton flavour violating transitions $\mu \rightarrow e \gamma$, $\mu \rightarrow 3e$ and the $\mu \rightarrow e$ conversion at atomic nuclei. It is investigated how they further restrict the remaining parameter spaces of the two leptoquark models. Also LHC limits for lepton flavour violation four-fermion interactions are regarded in a similar way. Finally, the results are assembled to a global picture. In this context, overview tables are presented summarising all determined constraints.
